notes.a28_1: Permits processing for the Processor's 'own legitimate business purposes' — breaches the Art.28(3)(a) 'documented instructions only' limit.
notes.c_transfer: International transfers permitted with no SCCs or Chapter V mechanism identified.
notes.c_breach_window: 'Without undue delay' with no fixed hours — negotiate a <=72h window to support the Controller's Art.33 duty.
notes.c_audit: Audit right limited to a biennial questionnaire; no for-cause or on-site audit.

reference_redline_hint: Remediate: Processing on Documented Instructions, Sub-processors, International Transfers, Personal Data Breach Notification, Audit Frequency and Scope, Liability.
